decisions.reason: As a visible step toward combining traditional woodcraft with technology, this product reflects the firm's stated direction and prior investment, so management is likely to continue it unless clear failure emerges.
This nativity stable sits squarely in the firm's established seasonal wooden décor business, making it easy to justify keeping as part of the core range even if early sales are only moderate.

Although its modern styling may be somewhat riskier with traditional buyers, it still fits the firm's move toward contemporary design and is likely to be retained while management attributes any weak start to market adjustment.
